candidates.name: 油彩風の環境画
candidates.style: Style/medium: Atmospheric painterly environment illustration in opaque oil-like digital paint. Broad confident but controlled brush strokes, finely judged edges, dimensional materials, light canvas grain. Strong readable value masses; detail concentrated on the sluice and daily-life objects. An authored painting, never a photorealistic render.
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: environment concept illustration for the original exploration game "Ash Estuary", early art-direction trial. One single image, wide landscape 16:9 composition.
Scene/backdrop: The old southern sluice of a small preindustrial coastal settlement. A worn white limestone paved path descends toward a modest stone sluice. On its inland side, a practical rainwater cistern with a stone rim and a separate drying yard with fishing nets hung on visibly metal frames. A quiet gray estuary is in the background. Every construction is ordinary human-scale infrastructure, maintained rather than abandoned.
Subject: Make the pale path, sluice, cistern and net racks readable as things that sustain daily life. Two small, unposed adult local workers in plain weathered work clothes quietly attend the site; their faces are not a focus. No hero pose.
Composition/framing: A grounded wide establishing view from the descending path, with a clear foreground, middle-ground sluice and background estuary. The intact white path gently draws the eye into the infrastructure; distinct silhouettes let the cistern and nets be read. Use exactly this scene and framing intent for a comparative art-direction study.
Lighting/mood: Soft overcast coastal daylight. Quiet, beautiful, slightly uneasy, with ordinary human labor beneath the beautiful surface. Legible shadow detail and restrained atmospheric distance. Neither a cheerful postcard nor an apocalyptic wasteland.
Color palette: Chalk white and warm ivory stone, slate-gray sea and sky, muted moss and blue-green, a little weathered rust and brown. Restrained saturation with luminous pale stone, no neon.
Materials/textures: Salt-worn limestone with subtle erosion, patched masonry, rough cloth, wet metal, net fibers and calm water.
Text: none.
World constraints: This is an arrival scene before any repairs or revelations. Keep the white path intact. The tide is not currently causing a catastrophe. Do not visualize the world's secret explanation, readable memories, extracted memories, ghosts, luminous memory crystals, supernatural birds or human bodily corrosion. Do not invent giant castles, monuments, monsters, combat, floating structures, modern machinery or industrial pipes.
Avoid: lettering, labels, borders, captions, symbols, diagrams, watermarks, generic epic fantasy spectacle, dramatic orange/teal grading, black crushed shadows, photorealistic CGI gloss.
Style/medium: Atmospheric painterly environment illustration in opaque oil-like digital paint. Broad confident but controlled brush strokes, finely judged edges, dimensional materials, light canvas grain. Strong readable value masses; detail concentrated on the sluice and daily-life objects. An authored painting, never a photorealistic render.

candidates.name: ペン画と淡彩
candidates.style: Style/medium: Delicate ink-and-watercolor travel sketch. Fine irregular pen outlines, varied hatching and subtly broken linework, translucent muted washes on warm textured paper. Keep a clear spatial environment and restrained color; small material observations carry the story. Not manga, not cartoon, not a technical diagram.

candidates.name: 平面的なガッシュ
candidates.style: Style/medium: Stylized matte gouache illustration. Simplified but credible architectural shapes, deliberate flat color planes, restrained cut-paper-like silhouettes, soft dry-brush grain and minimal contour lines. Depth through overlapping planes and values, rather than realistic micro-detail. Calm adult storybook atmosphere, not cute or toy-like.
